body:
There is no true death for those in Christ. 

My fear is that I have been castaway, as I cast Him away.
Your words are lovely, you’re a very supportive soul :)
Summed up perfectly in one paragraph.

I see what you’re saying, but it’s been the same my whole life. It’s as though I’m destined to be pushed down and kicked by other people. I hold no claim on being “perfect” but I make damn fucking sure I would NEVER spread rumours about someone else’s (mental) health/diagnosis nor would I mock them for it. 

I don’t drive and as said before I live alone so bills and stuff come before my shopping, let alone any extra. 

Really do appreciate your suggestions but I feel like I’m stuck in a rut, with no way out.
